description: Controlled three-layer Albanian astronomy atlas terminology reference; no code reads this catalogue in AST-TERM-001.

conventions.rule: Constellation titles standing alone use the definite form ("Orioni", "Arusha e Vogël"); sentences inflect freely.
conventions.approvalSource: owner session 2026-11-17, "Approve the proposed terminology in sections A, B, C and D as the Wave 1 editorial baseline, subject to these explicit amendments"

conventions.rule: Multi-word proper names capitalise every word except particles ("Arusha e Vogël", "Trekëndëshi Veror"); general terms are lowercase ("poli qiellor verior", "rrethpolar") except at the start of a label.
conventions.approvalSource: owner session 2026-11-17, "Approve the proposed terminology in sections A, B, C and D as the Wave 1 editorial baseline, subject to these explicit amendments"

conventions.rule: Star labels are the catalogue name from `bright-hyg-v41.json`, uninflected. Never invent a star identity. Polaris: canonical scientific label "Polaris"; first educational mention "Polaris (Ylli Polar)" (Kap. 1 §1.8); "Polari" is an Albanian prose/search alias only, never the primary figure label.
conventions.approvalSource: owner session 2026-11-17, "Approve the proposed terminology in sections A, B, C and D as the Wave 1 editorial baseline, subject to these explicit amendments"

conventions.rule: Displayed angles: one decimal with an Albanian decimal comma ("42,7°"); full precision in manifests and calculations.
conventions.approvalSource: owner session 2026-11-17, "Approve the proposed terminology in sections A, B, C and D as the Wave 1 editorial baseline, subject to these explicit amendments"

conventions.rule: Dates: "15 janar 2027"; months lowercase: janar, shkurt, mars, prill, maj, qershor, korrik, gusht, shtator, tetor, nëntor, dhjetor.
conventions.approvalSource: owner session 2026-11-17, "Approve the proposed terminology in sections A, B, C and D as the Wave 1 editorial baseline, subject to these explicit amendments"

conventions.rule: Time: 24-hour clock, local time first, then UTC: "15 janar 2027, ora 21:00 (CET, UTC+1) = 20:00 UTC"; summer "(CEST, UTC+2)".
conventions.approvalSource: owner session 2026-11-17, "Approve the proposed terminology in sections A, B, C and D as the Wave 1 editorial baseline, subject to these explicit amendments"

conventions.rule: Calculations use the verified IANA time-zone rules (tzdb has no `Europe/Pristina`; Kosovo maps to `Europe/Belgrade`, verified with tzdata 2026e). Dated figures display the Albanian location name, CET/CEST and the resolved UTC offset; the IANA identifier appears in the manifest only.
conventions.approvalSource: owner session 2026-11-17, "Approve the proposed terminology in sections A, B, C and D as the Wave 1 editorial baseline, subject to these explicit amendments"

conventions.rule: Albanian location name "Prishtina". "42,7° V, 21,2° L, 600 m" are representative display values, shown only when they are the display rounding of the actual observation parameters. Calculations always use the full-precision request parameters, never display-rounded values.
conventions.approvalSource: owner session 2026-11-17, "Approve the proposed terminology in sections A, B, C and D as the Wave 1 editorial baseline, subject to these explicit amendments"

openDecisions.text: U-1 Which star of `starHipIds` labels which ray of the AngularSeparation diagram (proposal: index 0 on the lower ray, index 1 on the reference ray). Decided in AST-ATLAS-001.

U-2 No abstract separation diagram exists today: `diagrams.py` at f0f7007 requires two catalogue HIP ids, and unnamed catalogue stars are already named "HIP <n>". "Objekti 1/2" is reserved for future abstract scenes.
U-3 Applying W1-B to `localization.py` and its tests (`test_extended_scenes.py` asserts "Zeniti"), with geometry-hash invariance: AST-ATLAS-001, not this task.
U-4 Ambiguous local times at the October DST change (02:00-03:00): explicit fold choice and printed resolved offset; AST-ATLAS-001.
U-5 Label for observations whose parameters are not Prishtina's (A8): proposal, place name only when the parameters match; otherwise coordinates only. Owner decision pending.
U-6 English-figure spelling "Prishtina" or "Pristina": owner decision pending.
U-7 Manuscript alignment (Kap. 1 / Draft 01 use "refraksioni", "Lartësia (h)", "Poli Qiellor i Veriut", "cirkumpolare", "Polari"): author's edits outside AstroIllustrator; no task.
D-4 Seasonal convention (evening time and date per season); four seasonal maps first, twelve monthly maps later (owner decision 2026-11-17).
D-6 Zodiac and sign labelling rule (proposal above).
D-9 Chapter numbering: the file "Kapitulli 1" covers Draft 01 outline chapters 1-3 and previews 5 and 6; numbering stays an open author decision. No chapter text is invented.
P-3 HYG v4.1 licensing (CC BY-SA 4.0) unresolved: internal development only; no commercial publication approval.

followUps.text:
Owner decision 2026-11-17: leave unchanged the five hard-coded bilingual
`scientificResults.title` values at f0f7007: "Horizon / Horizonti" (`charts.py:56`), "Angular
separation / Ndarja këndore" (`diagrams.py:24`), "Polaris — computed / e llogaritur"
(`diagrams.py:32`), "NCP latitude teaching diagram / Skemë mësimore" (`diagrams.py:36`),
"Altitude / Lartësia këndore — schematic" (`diagrams.py:41`). Recorded inconsistencies:
"Ndarja këndore" versus approved "Distanca këndore"; the others are fragments, not catalogue
terms. Changing them alters manifests and the reproducibility invariants, so a separate
proposal must assess that impact first. Not in this task's scope.
